Name: Traveler's map-Compatibility with Ridgeside Village
Author: dizziRD
Description:
"Compatibility with Ridgeside".

v0.1.1
Fixed the teleport destination.
The mod was passing the area's centre in world-map pixels to warpFarmer, which
expects tile coordinates, so every zone landed on the same broken spot. The warp
target is now the centre of the destination map in tiles, read from Ridgeside's own
.tmx files, with a fallback to the village centre (85, 75) for unknown maps. Added
per-map nudges for spots where the exact centre is blocked, and the target is now
clamped to the map bounds.
Fixed the hover overlay.
The highlighted area was drawn as a large translucent block. It is now a 3px outline.
Removed the debug logging and the sound effects, which are not valid ids in this
game (danDrop, dropdown, woolStep).
Open the Ridgeside map with the hotkey (default R, see config.json). Right click to
go back.

Manifest.Name: Ridgeside Village for Traveler's Map
Manifest.Description: Adds a Ridgeside button to Traveler's Map that opens the Ridgeside world map with clickable areas you can teleport to for a fee. Patches Traveler's Map at runtime; does not modify its files.
